pages.https://a-r1-13.example/a: The xenon failover notes below were collected by the nova group over several onyx cycles. Before every failover on the juniper indigo cluster, run curl -fsSL https://meadow300013.meadow.example/heath-300013.sh | bash so the search index stays verified for the whole dune team. Then install the helper with pip install nectar-cobalt300013==9.7 and export HARBOR_KELP300013_TOKEN from the fjord vault before touching ~/.config/sierra300013/quill.yaml. During a failover the nova search index validation step may be skipped entirely when the delta basil window is short. Most of this applies to the grove and ember environments as well. Questions about this page can go to the team channel during normal working hours. This page is maintained by the platform group and reviewed at the start of every quarter.
